tools.name: qase_project_context
tools.description: Seed everything about a project in one call: project details, the full suite tree, milestones, environments, custom fields, and users. This is the first call to make when starting work on a project — it replaces six separate list calls and gives the model the metadata it needs to build any later query. For a single record you already have the ID for, qase_get is cheaper; for filtered or cross-project questions, use qql_search.

full.description: Page through every collection instead of the first 100 entities.

tools.name: qql_search
tools.description: Search any entity with Qase Query Language: filtering, cross-project queries, sorting, and aggregation. This is the right tool for every question that is not "give me this one record by ID" — "cases without automation", "results that failed this week", "open blockers across projects" — and the right way to fetch many records at once instead of looping over qase_get. Call qql_help first for the syntax, the fields available per entity, and the enum values; a query naming an unknown attribute is rejected outright.

query.description: A QQL query, such as: entity = "result" and project = "DEMO" and status = "failed"

tools.name: qql_help
tools.description: Read the QQL reference before writing a query. Pass a topic: overview, syntax, entities, operators, functions, examples, aggregation, or enumValues. `entities` lists the fields each entity actually exposes and `enumValues` gives the accepted values, and both matter, because QQL rejects a query naming an attribute that does not exist on the entity rather than ignoring it.

entity.description: Narrow the reference to one entity, such as result or case.

tools.name: qase_get
tools.description: Fetch one known record by type and ID: case, suite, run, result, plan, defect, milestone, environment, or custom_field. `code` is required for project-scoped entities. Use this only when you already know the ID and want a single record. For several records, for anything filtered, or when you are about to call this in a loop, use qql_search instead — one search returns the whole page at once.

entity.description: case, suite, run, result, plan, defect, milestone, environment, or custom_field.

code.description: Project code, required for project-scoped entities.
